sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning # NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B BF16 is a large language model trained by NVIDIA for reasoning, agentic, and conversational workloads. It uses a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture with interleaved Mamba-2, MoE, and Attention layers, together with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP). This BF16 reference checkpoint has 30B total parameters and 3B active parameters ...
